_comment: Calibration constants for the Long Ball model, updated as real Fanatics boards come in. pool_size, k, alpha fit the ownership-from-odds curve est_entries = pool_size * k * implied_prob**alpha (alpha>1: the public over-concentrates on favorites).

entries_from_odds._fit_note: Fit to: Kurtz ~435 entries @ implied~0.30 (Jun12), Soderstrom 137 @ ~0.19, Caballero 5 @ ~0.06, Duran 1 @ ~0.04 (Jun14). Refit with calibrate.py as more boards with known pre-game odds are logged.

env._note: env_from_total(total) = clamp((total-base)*mult, +-cap). Gentled from 2.5/cap13 after Jun13 over-shot Sacramento (13.5 total -> +12.5 ft moonshots that never came).
